product.title: Pastel Bloom Mommy and Me Dresses - Sleeveless Sundress
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Lightweight polyester fabric with an airy drape that feels breezy and photo-ready for warm days.
  • Family story: A soft matching sundress moment for mom and daughter, made for beach walks, resort dinners, birthdays, and vacation photos.
  • Print: "Pastel Bloom" mixes watercolor florals, pastel petals, and soft greenery over a light cream ground.
  • Design details: Sleeveless cut, tie-front neckline, gently gathered waist, and a floaty skirt that moves beautifully in the breeze.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and use a cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size range: Girls Child 3 Years to Child 12 Years; Mother M to Mother L.

The Pastel Bloom Mommy and Me Dresses were built for the kind of days that deserve a little extra softness. The watercolor floral print feels light and airy against the seaside backdrop, while the sleeveless cut and gathered waist keep the silhouette relaxed, easy, and twirl-friendly for both mom and mini.

From beach photos to garden parties, this matching sundress set is all about effortless charm. The tie-front neckline adds a sweet detail up top, and the flowy skirt keeps every step breezy, making it an easy choice for warm-weather family moments that you want to remember.

Key Features:

  • Watercolor floral print: Soft pastel blooms and greenery create a dreamy summer look.
  • Breezy sleeveless fit: Lightweight woven construction keeps the silhouette easy and warm-weather friendly.
  • Tie-front detail: A sweet neckline accent adds polish without making the dress feel fussy.
  • Flowy gathered skirt: The full skirt moves beautifully for beach walks, vacations, and photos.
  • Mom and mini matching: Coordinated mother-and-daughter styling makes family dressing feel effortless.

Add your sizes and bring home a matching sundress set that feels ready for every sunny family plan.
